fixes.explanation: Yes, baker! Moses says, "…the LORD is their inheritance, as He promised them." (Deuteronomy 18:2) The Levites have no inheritance among their brothers, but they have Him. And Moses says He is the One who promised it. No land to call their own, but they have the LORD Himself.

Right on, baker. Moses says, "…because of these detestable things, the LORD your God is driving out the nations before you." (Deuteronomy 18:12) Just before that, he lists the things, like divination, sorcery and consulting a medium (Deuteronomy 18:10, 11). So the reason is the practices themselves, and Moses names them plainly.
